# Davy Keith & Marilla Cuthbert

- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Commands — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — since v2  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P58](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0058)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, following their mother's funeral. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, causing a scene at church by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's dress and later tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling in the pigpen. After being punished for his antics, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed as a prank. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises not to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on the condition that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) refrains from doing it again, and she carefully removes the toad from the bed before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) discuss Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village improvement projects, including the plan to paint the local hall green. However, due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a glaring bright blue with a red roof. Although the village is initially shocked by the hideous result, public sympathy shifts in favor of the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home from school feeling content and meets [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path). When she arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs her that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing, leading to a frantic search around the farm and well. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lied about it, but after a heart-to-heart conversation, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) understand the wrongness of lying before sending him to bed.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) addresses Davy's misbehavior in his bedroom, explaining why his lying was the dreadful consequence [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) warned him about. Afterwards, she joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) downstairs, and they laugh over Davy's antics before discussing how best to raise and discipline him.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> In a terrible mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a disaster-filled day at school, accidentally exploding a package of firecrackers brought by a student before whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. After venting her shame and regret to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is surprised the next morning when Anthony treats her with new respect. Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has finally won Anthony over by giving him a proper whipping.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and preparations for an upcoming bazaar. At home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle postponing his taking them, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a past conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) following his jam-stealing episode. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) meeting, the members are outraged to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and a committee sent to reason with him returns unsuccessful.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives exciting news in a letter that the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for dinner. After clearing up one of Davy's funny misconceptions about heaven, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enthusiastically plans an elaborate meal and prepares the house for the honored guest. She also visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to share the news and coordinate their preparations for the big event.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enthusiastically decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally destroys the lemon pies, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, and the green peas are ruined by too much sugar. To top off the series of misfortunes, Miss Barry's valuable platter is accidentally smashed, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) could not attend due to a sprained ankle.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> After cleaning up and seeing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be able to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a sprained ankle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the day's disappointments, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and chats with him before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals her to come over with news of a potential replacement willow-ware platter at the Copp place. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) to search for the platter, but upon finding the Copp home empty, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) climbs onto a small duck house to peek into the pantry window. She crashes through the roof and gets trapped, having to wait through a rainstorm until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her with an axe, after which Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) offers to sell her the platter over tea.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant late-August day rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and the twins before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) at his grandmother's house. Over tea and in his room, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) shares his imaginative thoughts and worries, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reassures him about. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts a jealous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and later meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> After putting [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) down by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to discuss their improvement society's progress and upcoming plans for the community. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the house and talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the following day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays home and handles chores, including transferring feathers between ticks, which leaves her covered in fluff. Mistaking a bottle of dye for her freckle lotion, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally colors her nose bright red right before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). After quickly washing off the dye, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) host the distinguished guests for a pleasant meal and a stroll through the local sights before they depart.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom antics from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) frightens her with ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set out to walk to a tea party in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), but accidentally wander down an enchanted wood lane that leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites the lost girls inside to join her for a tea party she had been playfully imagining by herself.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's ill health while reprimanding [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for his poor table manners. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has passed away and left money in trust for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), ensuring the twins can stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joke about their anonymous newspaper prank and Uncle Abe's storm prediction, but an extraordinarily severe hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on that exact date. The storm destroys crops, damages homes, kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and wrecks the trees planted by the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Afterwards, the community recovers and assesses the widespread damage, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolve to replant their lost trees next spring.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him, shocking the neighborhood. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) brings home local gossip about the couple's past separation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who reveals his newly scrubbed home and prepares to explain why he and his wife had parted ways.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated over his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and how they have now reconciled. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets acquainted with Mrs. Harrison, who walks her back across the fields, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) chatting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites the widowed Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), enabling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). News of Anne's resignation causes sorrow among her pupils and friends, though [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is delighted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their upcoming separations, local gossip, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> During lunch, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) recounts [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's misadventure at the brook, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to leave the table in amusement. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. After enjoying food, echoes, and conversation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head out into a nearby pasture to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House
